description: This file contains unit tests for the `HealthStore` component, specifically testing how the store's state responds to a probe failure on a linked channel within the `HealthSnapshot`. It defines a test case `linked channel probe failure degrades state` that sets up a snapshot with a failed probe and verifies the store's behavior.

classes.name: HealthStoreStateTests
classes.description: Contains the test method `linked channel probe failure degrades state` to validate the behavior of `HealthStore` under specific failure conditions.

methods.name: linked channel probe failure degrades state
methods.description: A test method that simulates a probe failure on a linked channel within the `HealthSnapshot` and verifies that `HealthStore` updates its state to `degraded` accordingly.
